description: A development team is preparing to move their three-service application to production. The application at /home/ga/webapp/ has a basic docker-compose.yml with no health checks, no resource limits, no restart policies, and flat networking. Harden the deployment for production by: (1) adding HEALTHCHECK directives to each service's Dockerfile or healthcheck entries in compose, (2) setting memory and CPU limits on all services, (3) configuring appropriate restart policies, and (4) implementing network isolation with at least two separate networks (frontend and backend). The application must remain fully functional at http://localhost:9080 after hardening. Modify the existing files at /home/ga/webapp/ — do not create a new directory. Login: ga / password123
